settings.heading: A measured ritual, on your terms.
settings.text:
Powder is the direct, mixable format for shoppers who already know the ritual they want. It offers flexibility, but it also asks for careful measuring and full attention to the exact label.

Final grind, origin, weight, serving, and ingredient language will remain tied to approved product records.
